kpis.name: Time to forward pass after own-half recovery (s)
kpis.description: Average time it takes a team to make a forward pass after recovering the ball in their own half per match.
kpis.display_name: Time to forward pass after own-half recovery (s)

kpis.name: First pass forward %
kpis.description: Percentage of first passes played forward after a ball recovery by a team per match.

kpis.name: Possessions to final third within 10s after own-half recovery %
kpis.description: Percentage of possessions that begin with a ball recovery in their own half and result in the team entering the final third within 10 seconds per match.
kpis.display_name: Possessions to final third within 10s after own-half recovery %

kpis.name: Possessions to box within 10s after att. half recovery %
kpis.description: Percentage of possessions that begin with a ball recovery in the attacking half and result in the team entering the penalty area within 10 seconds per match.
kpis.display_name: Possessions to box within 10s after att. half recovery %

kpis.name: Possessions retained after 5s %
kpis.description: Percentage of possessions by a team that lasted longer than 5 seconds after recovering the possession of the ball in open play per match.
